segments.text: Hello and welcome to the first of the 12-part series of BioRisk Management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎收看生物风险管理 12 集系列讲座的第一讲。

segments.text: Today's topic is Biological Agents.
segments.zh: 今天的主题是生物因子。

segments.text: This is our schedule for the next 12 months.
segments.zh: 这是我们未来 12 个月的安排。

segments.text: We have designed one lecture module per month in order to disseminate concepts pertaining to biological safety and biological security.
segments.zh: 我们设计了每月一个讲座模块，用来传播与生物安全和生物安保相关的概念。

segments.text: When we are first introduced to BioRisk Management, we have to understand that there are two aspects of BioRisk Management.
segments.zh: 初次接触生物风险管理时，我们必须了解生物风险管理包括两个方面。

segments.text: The first pertains to biosafety and the second pertains to biosecurity.
segments.zh: 第一个方面是生物安全，第二个方面是生物安保。

segments.text: What differentiates these two aspects is the intent.
segments.zh: 区分这两个方面的是意图。

segments.text: So in the case of biosafety, we focus on the unintentional release of biological agents.
segments.zh: 对于生物安全，我们关注的是生物因子的非故意释放。

segments.text: In the case of biosecurity, we focus on the intended release of a biological agent.
segments.zh: 对于生物安保，我们关注的是生物因子的蓄意释放。

segments.text: So throughout this lecture series, we will be focused on the AMP module, which basically pertains to risk assessment, risk mitigation and performance assessment.
segments.zh: 在整个系列讲座中，我们将重点讲解 AMP 模块，它基本上包括风险评估、风险缓解和绩效评估。

segments.text: So these three components are based on continuous quality improvement.
segments.zh: 这三个组成部分都建立在持续质量改进的基础之上。

segments.text: Let's look at biological agents.
segments.zh: 我们来看看生物因子。

segments.text: When we use the term biological agents, we refer to that from the context of biosafety.
segments.zh: 我们使用“生物因子”这个术语时，是从生物安全的角度来说的。

segments.text: However, in the case of biosecurity, we refer to biological agents as biological assets.
segments.zh: 而在生物安保中，我们把生物因子称为生物资产。

segments.text: Some of the keywords we will be using today are index case, morbidity, nosocomial, cutaneous, percutaneous and epidemiology.
segments.zh: 今天我们要用到的一些关键词有：指示病例、发病率、医院内的、皮肤的、经皮的以及流行病学。

segments.text: What is a biological agent?
segments.zh: 什么是生物因子？

segments.text: According to the Occupational Health and Safety Administration, biological agents include bacteria, viruses, fungi, other microorganisms and associated toxins.
segments.zh: 根据职业安全与健康管理局的定义，生物因子包括细菌、病毒、真菌、其他微生物以及相关的毒素。

segments.text: They have the ability to adversely affect human health in a variety of ways, ranging from relatively mild allergic reactions to serious medical conditions or even death.
segments.zh: 它们能够以多种方式对人体健康产生不良影响，从相对轻微的过敏反应到严重的疾病，甚至死亡。

segments.text: Now the key message which we should remember in this definition is that biological agents adversely affect human health.
segments.zh: 在这个定义中，我们应该记住的关键信息是：生物因子会对人体健康产生不良影响。

segments.text: There are various classes of biological agents.
segments.zh: 生物因子有多种类别。

segments.text: One of the least common are prions, which have been linked to what is commonly referred to as the mad cow disease.
segments.zh: 最不常见的之一是朊病毒，它与通常所说的疯牛病有关。

segments.text: So they are a family of progressive neurodegenerative disorders.
segments.zh: 它们会引起一类进行性神经退行性疾病。

segments.text: So prion diseases are spread through animal hosts.
segments.zh: 朊病毒病通过动物宿主传播。

segments.text: The second least common is mycoplasma.
segments.zh: 第二不常见的是支原体。

segments.text: So one of the common biological agents is mycoplasma pneumoniae.
segments.zh: 常见的生物因子之一是肺炎支原体。

segments.text: It's an atypical bacterium.
segments.zh: 它是一种非典型细菌。

segments.text: It does not have a cell wall and does not respond to treatment with beta-lectum antibiotics.
segments.zh: 它没有细胞壁，对 β-内酰胺类抗生素治疗无效。

segments.text: So we need to use macrolides.
segments.zh: 所以我们需要使用大环内酯类药物。

segments.text: So mycoplasma is one of the biological agents, which is atypical, which means it's the only type of bacterium in its class.
segments.zh: 所以支原体是一种非典型的生物因子，也就是说，它是同类中唯一的一种细菌。

segments.text: Viruses are very commonly known.
segments.zh: 病毒是大家非常熟悉的。

segments.text: And the most pathogenic viruses are the positive single-stranded RNA viruses, which include the Ebola virus, the maba virus, and the hunter viruses.
segments.zh: 致病性最强的病毒是正链单股 RNA 病毒，其中包括埃博拉病毒、马尔堡病毒和汉坦病毒。

segments.text: So viruses can cause viral hemorrhagic fevers.
segments.zh: 病毒可以引起病毒性出血热。

segments.text: And these are potentially lethal.
segments.zh: 这些疾病可能致命。

segments.text: And in many cases, treatment for these viruses does not exist.
segments.zh: 而且在很多情况下，针对这些病毒的治疗方法并不存在。

segments.text: Among the bacteria, we have various types of bacteria.
segments.zh: 细菌方面，我们有各种类型的细菌。

segments.text: For instance, we have bacillus anthracis, which is widely known.
segments.zh: 例如，有众所周知的炭疽芽孢杆菌。

segments.text: It's a soil bacterium.
segments.zh: 它是一种土壤细菌。

segments.text: And the production of spores and their dispersals through aerosols is a potential hazard.
segments.zh: 它会产生芽孢，芽孢通过气溶胶扩散是一种潜在危害。

segments.text: We have bulcoidea species, which are found in soils, vibrio and leptospyran.
segments.zh: 还有存在于土壤中的伯克霍尔德菌属、弧菌和钩端螺旋体。

segments.text: These are some of the common bacteria which are associated with biological hazards.
segments.zh: 这些是与生物危害相关的一些常见细菌。

segments.text: Among the yeast, we have yeast such as cryptococcus neiformans, which is an encapsulated yeast, and which is pathogenic,
segments.zh: 酵母菌方面，有新型隐球菌这样的酵母菌，它是一种有荚膜的酵母菌，具有致病性，

segments.text: especially in the case of immunocompromised patients.
segments.zh: 特别是对免疫功能低下的患者而言。

segments.text: In addition to yeast, we also have fungi, which have the ability to be dispersed via spores.
segments.zh: 除了酵母菌，还有能够通过孢子传播的真菌。

segments.text: So aspergillus flavors can cause infection.
segments.zh: 黄曲霉可以引起感染。

segments.text: In fact, aspergillus flavors produces aflatoxin.
segments.zh: 事实上，黄曲霉会产生黄曲霉毒素。

segments.text: We have histoplasma, which is spread by guano, or in the feces of birds, and candida albicans,
segments.zh: 还有通过鸟粪，也就是鸟类粪便传播的组织胞浆菌，以及白色念珠菌，

segments.text: which is a common cell yeast.
segments.zh: 它是一种常见的共生酵母菌。

segments.text: However, in immunocompromised patients, it can manifest as an infection.
segments.zh: 但在免疫功能低下的患者中，它可能表现为感染。

segments.text: In addition to this, caution should be taken when working with DNA and RNA,
segments.zh: 此外，在处理 DNA 和 RNA 时也应谨慎，

segments.text: because DNA and RNA represent potential infectious agents.
segments.zh: 因为 DNA 和 RNA 是潜在的感染因子。

segments.text: As has been reported in a paper, novel virus RNA is infectious in mammalian cells.
segments.zh: 正如一篇论文所报道的，某种新型病毒的 RNA 在哺乳动物细胞中具有感染性。

segments.text: In addition to the naturally occurring infectious agents, genetically modified infectious agents represent a threat as well.
segments.zh: 除了自然存在的感染因子，经过基因改造的感染因子也构成威胁。

segments.text: Modifications which increase virulence, expand the host range,
segments.zh: 那些增强毒力、扩大宿主范围、

segments.text: improve the resistance, or increase resistance to therapeutic agents, such as antibiotics,
segments.zh: 提高抗性或增强对抗生素等治疗药物的耐药性、

segments.text: and which mask their antigens from host immune system.
segments.zh: 以及使其抗原躲避宿主免疫系统的改造。

segments.text: All these modifications can lead to a potential biological threat.
segments.zh: 所有这些改造都可能导致潜在的生物威胁。

segments.text: In addition to this, we have other parasites, like backbone parasites,
segments.zh: 此外，还有其他寄生虫，比如媒介传播的寄生虫，

segments.text: such as those spread by the Aedes aegypti,
segments.zh: 例如由埃及伊蚊传播的寄生虫，

segments.text: as well as schistosoma, which is spread by aquatic snails.
segments.zh: 以及由水生螺类传播的血吸虫。

segments.text: We have ticks and fleas, which can serve as vectors for the transmission of bacterial pathogens,
segments.zh: 还有蜱和跳蚤，它们可以作为传播细菌性病原体的媒介，

segments.text: as well as ricin and other biologically derived toxins,
segments.zh: 以及蓖麻毒素和其他生物来源的毒素，

segments.text: which have the potential to cause harm even though they are non-living.
segments.zh: 它们虽然不是活体，但也有可能造成伤害。

segments.text: So, we have a wide range of biological agents. How are they classified?
segments.zh: 所以，生物因子的范围很广。它们是如何分类的呢？

segments.text: Biological agents are classified according to their risk group.
segments.zh: 生物因子是按照风险等级组来分类的。

segments.text: Risk group 1 do not cause diseases in healthy adult humans.
segments.zh: 风险等级 1 组不会使健康的成年人致病。

segments.text: Lactobacillus, Lactis is a perfect example, it's a probiotic, it causes no harm.
segments.zh: 乳酸乳杆菌就是一个很好的例子，它是一种益生菌，不会造成任何伤害。

segments.text: Risk group 2 cause disease in humans, but the disease is treatable or preventable.
segments.zh: 风险等级 2 组会使人致病，但这种疾病是可以治疗或预防的。

segments.text: Therapies exist and the treatment protocols are well-defined.
segments.zh: 有现成的疗法，而且治疗方案明确。

segments.text: Risk group 3 organisms can cause serious diseases in humans.
segments.zh: 风险等级 3 组的生物体可以使人患上严重疾病。

segments.text: You can have mortality as well as morbidity.
segments.zh: 可能导致死亡，也可能导致发病。

segments.text: However, treatment exists and vaccines for the diseases have been developed.
segments.zh: 不过，有治疗方法，而且针对这些疾病的疫苗也已研制出来。

segments.text: In the case of risk group 4, for example, in the Simeon herpes virus,
segments.zh: 至于风险等级 4 组，例如猴疱疹病毒，

segments.text: they cause deadly disease and there is no treatment or vaccine available for this kind of pathogen.
segments.zh: 它们会引起致命疾病，而且对这类病原体没有可用的治疗方法或疫苗。

segments.text: One of the widely used references is the pathogen safety data sheet.
segments.zh: 广泛使用的参考资料之一是病原体安全数据表。

segments.text: These pathogen safety data sheets have been developed by the Public Health Agency of Canada
segments.zh: 这些病原体安全数据表由加拿大公共卫生署编制，

segments.text: and they give an overview of the risk group as well as the therapeutic procedures
segments.zh: 概述了病原体的风险等级组，以及临床医生

segments.text: which can be adopted by a clinician in the case of infection.
segments.zh: 在发生感染时可以采用的治疗方法。

segments.text: Now, we work in a laboratory setting.
segments.zh: 我们是在实验室环境中工作的。

segments.text: So, what increases the level of risk is the processing of samples.
segments.zh: 所以，增加风险水平的是样本的处理。

segments.text: For instance, in this case, you can see that storage does not pose a significant risk
segments.zh: 例如，在这个例子中，大家可以看到储存并不构成重大风险，

segments.text: because in a stored state, the bacterium or the biological agent is in a dormant state.
segments.zh: 因为在储存状态下，细菌或者说生物因子处于休眠状态。

segments.text: However, when this bacterium is thawed and brought into the lab for diagnosis,
segments.zh: 然而，当这种细菌被解冻并带进实验室进行诊断时，

segments.text: it poses a risk to the environment as well as to the laboratory worker.
segments.zh: 它就会对环境和实验室工作人员构成风险。

segments.text: When this organism is cultured, for instance, for development of vaccines or attenuated viruses,
segments.zh: 当这种生物体被培养时，例如用于研制疫苗或减毒病毒，

segments.text: they can pose a risk to the larger context which means the laboratory worker as well as the environment.
segments.zh: 它们可能会在更大范围内构成风险，也就是对实验室工作人员和环境都构成风险。

segments.text: So, as you can see in this depiction, the modification of viruses or the application of technologies
segments.zh: 所以，正如大家在这张示意图中看到的，对病毒进行改造，或者应用各种技术

segments.text: to process risk groups or in this case, viruses can lead to greater levels of risk
segments.zh: 来处理各风险等级组的生物因子，在这里是病毒，都可能导致更高的风险水平，

segments.text: and these need to be taken into account when you are working in a laboratory setting.
segments.zh: 在实验室环境中工作时必须考虑到这些。

segments.text: So, we will be discussing risk in more detail in future lectures.
segments.zh: 我们将在以后的讲座中更详细地讨论风险。

segments.text: But just to touch upon risk, risk is a function of likelihood and consequence.
segments.zh: 这里只简单提一下，风险是可能性和后果的函数。

segments.text: When we speak of likelihood, we ask the question, what is the probability of?
segments.zh: 谈到可能性时，我们问的问题是：发生……的概率是多少？

segments.text: When we speak of consequence, we ask the question, what would happen if?
segments.zh: 谈到后果时，我们问的问题是：如果……会发生什么？

segments.text: So, this is a risk matrix which defines likelihood and consequence.
segments.zh: 这是一个定义可能性和后果的风险矩阵。

segments.text: So, a risk with a likelihood and consequence of 1 and 1 represents a low risk.
segments.zh: 可能性和后果分别为 1 和 1 的风险，代表低风险。

segments.text: A risk with a likelihood and consequence of 5 and 5 represents a high risk.
segments.zh: 可能性和后果分别为 5 和 5 的风险，代表高风险。

segments.text: Now, this is an indicator matrix which can be used for risk assessment.
segments.zh: 这是一个可用于风险评估的指示矩阵。

segments.text: So, how do we assess risk?
segments.zh: 那么，我们如何评估风险呢？

segments.text: What are the questions that we need to ask when we assess risk?
segments.zh: 评估风险时，我们需要提出哪些问题？

segments.text: The first question which we need to ask is the risk group.
segments.zh: 我们需要问的第一个问题是风险等级组。

segments.text: Which risk group does my biological agent belong to?
segments.zh: 我的生物因子属于哪个风险等级组？

segments.text: Which risk group can it be assigned to?
segments.zh: 可以把它划入哪个风险等级组？

segments.text: The second question is the root of infection.
segments.zh: 第二个问题是感染途径。

segments.text: Do we get infected by inhalation, aerosols?
segments.zh: 我们是通过吸入、气溶胶而被感染的吗？

segments.text: Do we get infected by a contact which is percutaneous and cutaneous?
segments.zh: 是通过经皮和皮肤的接触而被感染的吗？

segments.text: Do we get infected by an injection which is percutaneous?
segments.zh: 是通过经皮的注射而被感染的吗？

segments.text: Or do we get infected by an injection?
segments.zh: 还是通过食入而被感染的？

segments.text: The second aspect which we need to address is the mode of transmission.
segments.zh: 我们需要关注的第二个方面是传播方式。

segments.text: If a vector is involved in the transmission of a virus from one human host to another,
segments.zh: 如果病毒从一个人类宿主传播到另一个人类宿主的过程中涉及媒介，

segments.text: does this virus get transmitted directly as in the case of the Zika virus?
segments.zh: 这种病毒是像寨卡病毒那样直接传播的吗？

segments.text: Or does it have to go through the host life cycle as in the case of the Aedes aegypti carrying virus?
segments.zh: 还是必须像埃及伊蚊携带的病毒那样，经过宿主的生命周期？

segments.text: Some of the host may be diverse.
segments.zh: 有些宿主可能是多种多样的。

segments.text: For instance, Cryptococcus is actually present in plants,
segments.zh: 例如，隐球菌实际上存在于植物中，

segments.text: spread by spores and infects humans.
segments.zh: 通过孢子传播并感染人类。

segments.text: But it's also present in bird excreta or in bird droppings.
segments.zh: 但它也存在于鸟类排泄物，也就是鸟粪中。

segments.text: And these can be vectors for the transmission of this specific pathogen.
segments.zh: 这些都可能成为传播这种特定病原体的媒介。

segments.text: In addition to the root of transmission, we also have to look at the host range.
segments.zh: 除了传播途径，我们还要看宿主范围。

segments.text: Some viruses can survive and propagate in multiple series of host.
segments.zh: 有些病毒可以在多种宿主中存活和繁殖。

segments.text: They can propagate in mammals as well as in snails.
segments.zh: 它们既可以在哺乳动物体内繁殖，也可以在螺类体内繁殖。

segments.text: So we need to consider this aspect when we develop a bioresk management plan.
segments.zh: 所以在制定生物风险管理计划时，我们需要考虑这一点。

segments.text: The next question is infectious dose.
segments.zh: 下一个问题是感染剂量。

segments.text: How much of the biological agent is required in order to cause harm?
segments.zh: 需要多少生物因子才能造成伤害？

segments.text: In this case, morbidity or mortality.
segments.zh: 在这里，伤害指的是发病或死亡。

segments.text: The next aspect is endemicity.
segments.zh: 下一个方面是地方流行性。

segments.text: Is the biological agent endemic to this specific region?
segments.zh: 这种生物因子在这个特定地区是否属于地方性流行？

segments.text: So if a biological agent is endemic to a specific region,
segments.zh: 如果一种生物因子在某个特定地区，

segments.text: a geographic region in this case,
segments.zh: 这里指的是某个地理区域，属于地方性流行，

segments.text: it is likely that individuals who are endemic to that region
segments.zh: 那么这个地区的本地居民

segments.text: have developed some level of immunity to this biological agent.
segments.zh: 很可能已经对这种生物因子产生了一定程度的免疫力。

segments.text: In addition to this, we need to look at the immune status of the laboratory worker.
segments.zh: 此外，我们还需要了解实验室工作人员的免疫状况。

segments.text: Is the laboratory worker immunocompromised?
segments.zh: 实验室工作人员是否免疫功能低下？

segments.text: So if they are immunocompromised,
segments.zh: 如果他们免疫功能低下，

segments.text: we need to put in place measures to mitigate the risk posed to this laboratory worker.
segments.zh: 我们就需要采取措施，降低这名实验室工作人员面临的风险。

segments.text: So finally, we come down to the risk assessment,
segments.zh: 最后，我们来到风险评估，

segments.text: which is basically a series of questions which we ask.
segments.zh: 它基本上就是我们要问的一系列问题。

segments.text: What is the biological agent?
segments.zh: 这是什么生物因子？

segments.text: What is the risk group which can be assigned to?
segments.zh: 可以把它划入哪个风险等级组？

segments.text: Is it endemic or exotic?
segments.zh: 它是本地流行的还是外来的？

segments.text: Which risk group can it be assigned to?
segments.zh: 可以把它划入哪个风险等级组？

segments.text: What is the mode of transmission?
segments.zh: 传播方式是什么？

segments.text: What is the root of infection?
segments.zh: 感染途径是什么？

segments.text: What is the infectious dose?
segments.zh: 感染剂量是多少？

segments.text: And is treatment available?
segments.zh: 是否有治疗方法？

segments.text: When we do risk assessment in the laboratory,
segments.zh: 在实验室中进行风险评估时，

segments.text: these are some of the questions which we need to ask.
segments.zh: 这些是我们需要问的一些问题。

segments.text: What is the immune status of the laboratory workers?
segments.zh: 实验室工作人员的免疫状况如何？

segments.text: What are the processes that will be employed in the laboratory workers
segments.zh: 实验室工作人员将采用哪些操作过程，

segments.text: as well as the volume of the culture which is going to be processed?
segments.zh: 以及要处理的培养物的体积有多大？

segments.text: How many processes are involved?
segments.zh: 涉及多少个操作过程？

segments.text: Does the laboratory work involve a single step
segments.zh: 实验室工作是只涉及单一步骤，

segments.text: or does it encompass multiple steps?
segments.zh: 还是包含多个步骤？

segments.text: How many workers are exposed?
segments.zh: 有多少工作人员会受到暴露？

segments.text: Have they been trained?
segments.zh: 他们是否接受过培训？

segments.text: And has the facility been designed for a specific purpose?
segments.zh: 设施是否是为特定用途而设计的？

segments.text: When we do risk assessment,
segments.zh: 进行风险评估时，

segments.text: we always address the iceberg analogy
segments.zh: 我们总是会提到冰山的比喻，

segments.text: in which case a large portion of the risk is actually present but not visible
segments.zh: 也就是说，很大一部分风险实际上是存在的，但是看不见，

segments.text: and you may not be able to assess this risk
segments.zh: 而且你可能无法用传统的方法或传统的问题

segments.text: using traditional approaches or traditional questions
segments.zh: 来评估这部分风险，

segments.text: because there is no knowledge pertaining to previous cases.
segments.zh: 因为没有以往病例的相关知识。

segments.text: We can only see the risk which is visible
segments.zh: 我们只能看到那些可见的风险，

segments.text: or which appears as a result of specific questions.
segments.zh: 或者通过特定问题显现出来的风险。

segments.text: So in this case, we assume the highest level of risk.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，我们假定风险处于最高水平。

segments.text: So pertaining to the iceberg analogy,
segments.zh: 所以，根据冰山的比喻，

segments.text: we always assume the highest level of risk
segments.zh: 对于以下情况，我们总是假定风险处于最高水平：

segments.text: in the case of genetically engineered molecules,
segments.zh: 基因工程分子，

segments.text: be it RNA or DNA.
segments.zh: 无论是 RNA 还是 DNA；

segments.text: Rosocomial samples which may contain a multiplicity
segments.zh: 可能含有多种生物因子或病原体的

segments.text: of biological agents or pathogens.
segments.zh: 医院内样本；

segments.text: Soil samples which may lead to potential sporulation
segments.zh: 可能导致潜在孢子形成，

segments.text: or which may lead to the development of bacteria or fungi with spores.
segments.zh: 或者可能导致产孢细菌或真菌生长的土壤样本；

segments.text: Samples run from healthy organisms
segments.zh: 取自健康生物体的样本，

segments.text: which may not present the symptoms of infection.
segments.zh: 它们可能不表现出感染症状，

segments.text: However, which may be a host for that specific pathogen.
segments.zh: 但可能是该特定病原体的宿主；

segments.text: And samples derived from vile animals.
segments.zh: 以及取自野生动物的样本。

segments.text: So once we address or assess the risk,
segments.zh: 所以，一旦我们处理或评估了风险，

segments.text: we then mitigate the risk by the application of five controls
segments.zh: 就要通过实施五种控制措施来缓解风险，

segments.text: which are elimination, substitution, engineering controls,
segments.zh: 即消除、替代、工程控制、

segments.text: administrative controls and personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 管理控制和个人防护装备。

segments.text: Once we have applied the control,
segments.zh: 实施了控制措施之后，

segments.text: we assess the performance of our controls
segments.zh: 我们要通过对操作过程

segments.text: by carrying out an audit of the processes
segments.zh: 和标准操作规程进行审核，

segments.text: and the standard operating procedures.
segments.zh: 来评估控制措施的效果。

segments.text: These are some of the references
segments.zh: 这些是制作本讲解时

segments.text: which have been relied upon to develop this presentation.
segments.zh: 所依据的一些参考资料。

segments.text: Our next module will focus on risk assessment.
segments.zh: 我们的下一个模块将重点讲解风险评估。

segments.text: Thank you for participating in this BiRisk Management Series.
segments.zh: 感谢大家参与本生物风险管理系列讲座。
